  <bpmn:process id="PROCESS" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LANES">
      <bpmn:lane id="L_FD" name="Fault detector">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>s1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>report</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="L_MPO" name="MPO">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>s2</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>mergeStart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>examine</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>confirmed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>rejectEnd</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>split1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>informGO</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>informMSP</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>join1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>fix</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>share</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>split2</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>resGO</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>resMSP</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>join2</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>doneEnd</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="s1" name="Fault detector detects failure" />
    <bpmn:task id="report" name="Report the failure to the MPO" />
    <bpmn:startEvent id="s2" name="MPO suspects own fault" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="mergeStart" />
    <bpmn:task id="examine" name="Examine the failure" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="confirmed" name="Failure confirmed?" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="rejectEnd" name="Failure rejected" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="split1" />
    <bpmn:task id="informGO" name="Inform the GO about the failure" />
    <bpmn:task id="informMSP" name="Inform the MSP about the failure" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="join1" />
    <bpmn:task id="fix" name="Fix the fault at the measuring device" />
    <bpmn:task id="share" name="Share the results of the repairs with the fault detector" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="split2" />
    <bpmn:task id="resGO" name="Inform the GO about the resolution of the interference" />
    <bpmn:task id="resMSP" name="Inform the MSP about the resolution of the interference" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="join2" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="doneEnd" name="Fault resolved" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="s1" targetRef="report" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="report" targetRef="mergeStart" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f3" sourceRef="s2" targetRef="mergeStart" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f4" sourceRef="mergeStart" targetRef="examine" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f5" sourceRef="examine" targetRef="confirmed" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f6" name="no" sourceRef="confirmed" targetRef="rejectEnd" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f7" name="yes" sourceRef="confirmed" targetRef="split1" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f10" sourceRef="informGO" targetRef="join1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f11" sourceRef="informMSP" targetRef="join1" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f12" sourceRef="join1" targetRef="fix" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f13" sourceRef="fix" targetRef="share" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f14" sourceRef="share" targetRef="split2" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f15" sourceRef="split2" targetRef="resGO" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f16" sourceRef="split2" targetRef="resMSP" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f17" sourceRef="resGO" targetRef="join2" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f18" sourceRef="resMSP" targetRef="join2" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f19" sourceRef="join2" targetRef="doneEnd" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
